obligations.text: Every normal or build dependency of a release member that is a workspace crate is itself a member of the same release, in an earlier crate layer.
A crate's layer is one past the deepest layer of its member dependencies, recomputed from cargo metadata at the candidate commit; the release-set file must equal that recomputation.

sectionHeadings: 045: The command surface in the release family (amends 031)
record.summary: A narrow amendment of approved spec 031 (itself amending spec 021). Spec 027 adds `rustev-surface`, the pure command renderer every host calls, and requires the CLI to call it instead of its own copy. The CLI is a published release member, so its new dependency must be published first, in a crate layer of its own: 031 3.1's layer table has no slot between `rustev-eval` and the CLI. This spec adds `rustev-surface` to the release family, states the crate layers as the topological levels the release policy already computes from `cargo metadata`, admits a crate that a release member depends on once the crate exists and passes its checks, and keeps the release-set test's member list as the deliberate, reviewed record of membership. Ratified by the owner on 2026-10-20 (A-42).
